name: the old smithy at Hollin
notes: Training level A5 (D-59): the yard of a ruined smithy where an old soldier lives. Fields as in data/maps/village.json.

art.ground: a cobbled smithy yard with patches of cinders, weeds between the stones, and a muddy track at the bottom

pieces.Forge: a roofless ruined stone smithy with a cold forge hearth and a broken chimney, door facing down
pieces.Anvil: a heavy iron anvil on a tree-stump block
pieces.Trough: a stone quenching trough full of water
pieces.Grindstone: a big round sandstone grindstone on a wooden frame with a crank handle
pieces.Dummy: a straw-stuffed sacking practice dummy on a wooden post, with a painted face
pieces.Scrap: a heap of rusty scrap iron, old blades and broken tools
pieces.Bench: a sturdy wooden workbench with tools on it
pieces.Woodpile: a stack of rough poles and planks
